dedupe_keys.name: drinking water inspectorate dwi annual drinking water quality reports and company performance data for england and wales

description: The Drinking Water Inspectorate, formed in 1990 to give independent reassurance that public water supplies in England and Wales are safe and acceptable to consumers, publishes an annual report on drinking water quality together with company-level performance figures. The DWI regulates the water companies, private water supplies, drinking water products and, under the NIS regulations, the security and emergency resilience of the water sector. Coverage: England and Wales; the Drinking Water 2025 report (presented on 7 and 9 July 2026) covers public and private water supplies, with separate summaries for England and Wales, interim reports and private supply reports; the company performance data give, for every water company, its size in quantity supplied and an overview of water quality at treatment works, service reservoirs and water supply zones, updated each July. Format and access: HTML and PDF reports and an HTML company performance report on dwi.gov.uk; free. Licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where stated, Crown copyright. Caveats: the company data are published as an embedded report, not a downloadable table on the pages read, so their exact fields and any file download were not checked; figures are annual summaries, not sample-level results. Simulation uses: water quality compliance and supply zone baselines for capacity planning, emergency response and climate adaptation of drinking water systems. Related records: the DiscoverWater dashboard (data-discover-water-company-performance-dashboard) reports the same companies' wider service performance.
